leagueRules.title: League rules
leagueRules.intro: Transparent, fair and clear: how records, divisions, rankings and seasons are scored in the Ultimate European Hiking League.
leagueRules.permanentRanking: The Ultimate European Hiking League is a permanent ranking for long-distance hikers.
leagueRules.placementDistanceOnly: Overall placement is based exclusively on the total kilometres accumulated.
leagueRules.divisionsDescribeProfile: Divisions classify performance profiles and do not determine placement in the Overall Ranking.
leagueRules.calendarYear: A season corresponds to one calendar year.
leagueRules.seasonReset: The season ranking resets at the start of each new season.
leagueRules.seasonArchives: Past seasons remain archived and are intended to remain visible in the profile over the long term.
leagueRules.recordDefinition: A record is a documented hike completed by a participant.
leagueRules.elapsedTime: Total elapsed time of the hike
leagueRules.minimumDistance: A record generally counts from 10 km.
leagueRules.minimumElevation: Below 10 km, a record counts only if at least 600 metres of elevation gain were reached.
leagueRules.privateHikesAllowed: Private hikes are expressly permitted and count towards a participant's total kilometres.
leagueRules.privateGpsEvidence: A private hike requires a GPS track as evidence.
leagueRules.privateData: The hike must be submitted with complete and plausible data.
leagueRules.privateOverall: Private hikes count towards the Overall Ranking.
leagueRules.privateClassification: Private hikes do not count towards division classification.
leagueRules.privatePromotion: Private hikes do not count towards promotion or relegation between divisions.
leagueRules.officialEventsAssessPerformance: Official events are the basis for assessing performance within divisions.
leagueRules.onlyEventResults: Only event results are used for division assessment.
leagueRules.privateNoImpact: Private hikes do not affect the division.
leagueRules.officialTrackThreshold: At official events, a GPS track must cover at least 97% of the required official distance if a track is used as evidence.
leagueRules.elapsedTimeOnly: All speed calculations use only the actual total elapsed time of the hike from start to finish.
leagueRules.walkingTime: Active walking time does not count.
leagueRules.adjustedTime: Adjusted times that exclude breaks do not count.
leagueRules.confirmedEventTimes: Only events with a confirmed total elapsed time are included in the division calculation.
leagueRules.divisionThresholds: 7. Divisions and speed thresholds in km/h
leagueRules.confirmedAverage: The Ultimate Hiking League has three performance divisions. Each official event result with a confirmed elapsed time receives an event performance tier based on its average speed.
leagueRules.goldRange: From 4.80 km/h up to but below 5.80 km/h
leagueRules.platinumRange: 5.80 km/h and above, with no upper limit
leagueRules.speedFormula: The average speed for an event is the distance covered divided by the total elapsed time.
leagueRules.eventTierAndProfile: The event performance tier describes a single event result. The profile division is the hiker’s current league division. A hiker in the Gold profile division can earn a Platinum tier at an event.
leagueRules.defaultSilver: New participants and those with too few confirmed official event results start in the Silver Division.
leagueRules.rollingCalculation: 8. Rolling review of the profile division
leagueRules.dynamicDivision: A hiker’s profile division can change based on their performances at official events.
leagueRules.basicRule: The rolling review follows these rules.
leagueRules.rollingConfirmedTime: Only verified official event results with a recorded average speed count.
leagueRules.rollingPrivateExcluded: Private hikes do not affect the profile division.
leagueRules.rollingEventTier: Each eligible event has its own performance tier (Silver, Gold or Platinum), based on its speed.
leagueRules.rollingThreeEvents: Promotion is based on the performance tiers of the 3 most recent eligible events.
leagueRules.rollingFiveEvents: Relegation is based on the performance tiers of the 5 most recent eligible events.
leagueRules.rollingOrder: Results are ordered by activity date, newest first. If two results share a date, the higher record ID comes first.
leagueRules.rollingFormula: The rolling review does not average speeds across events. The tier earned at each of the relevant events determines the outcome.
leagueRules.promotionThreeResults: A hiker can move up if they reach at least the tier of the next division at each of their 3 most recent eligible events.
leagueRules.silverToGold: Silver to Gold: Each of the 3 most recent eligible events must have a Gold or Platinum tier. For example, Gold – Platinum – Gold earns promotion from Silver to Gold.
leagueRules.goldToPlatinum: Gold to Platinum: Each of the 3 most recent eligible events must have a Platinum tier. For example, Platinum – Platinum – Platinum earns promotion from Gold to Platinum.
leagueRules.promotionExample: One Platinum result cannot make up for two Gold results. Speeds of 5.44 / 5.52 / 7.08 km/h produce Gold – Gold – Platinum, so a Gold hiker stays in Gold.
leagueRules.relegationFiveResults: Relegation is assessed using the 5 most recent eligible event results.
leagueRules.platinumToGold: Platinum to Gold: Each of the 5 most recent eligible events must have a Gold or Silver tier.
leagueRules.goldToSilver: Gold to Silver: Each of the 5 most recent eligible events must have a Silver tier.
leagueRules.relegationInterrupted: A single result at or above the hiker’s current profile division breaks the streak required for relegation.
leagueRules.movementStep: Hikers move up or down one division at a time. There is no automatic promotion through multiple divisions. An event’s performance tier stays the same regardless of the hiker’s current profile division.
leagueRules.rankDistanceOnly: The rankings, both overall and within a division, are based exclusively on the total kilometres covered.
leagueRules.speedAndRank: Speed does not affect ranking position.
leagueRules.silverBeforePlatinum: A Silver hiker can therefore rank ahead of a Platinum hiker in the Overall Ranking.
leagueRules.eventDefinition: An event is defined by its name, date, location and official distance.
leagueRules.eventVariants: Different distances at the same event are treated as separate event variants.
leagueRules.skyscraperSeparate: In addition to the main distance-based league, there is a Skyscraper Ranking for elevation gain.
leagueRules.elevationSum: The total of all plausibly recorded elevation gain is counted.
leagueRules.elevationVisibility: A participant becomes visible once they reach a total of 1,500 metres of elevation gain within one season.
leagueRules.elevationOnly: The Skyscraper Ranking is based exclusively on elevation gain.
leagueRules.distanceSpeedExcluded: Kilometres and km/h do not affect the Skyscraper Ranking.
leagueRules.skyscraperParallel: Skyscraper runs alongside Silver, Gold and Platinum.
leagueRules.linkProfile: Participants can claim existing profiles and link them to their own account.
leagueRules.claimDetails: A claim may require first and last name, and the date, location and distance of an event.
leagueRules.claimEvidence: A GPS track or personalised finisher evidence may be required.
leagueRules.afterClaim: After a successful claim, participants can add records, expand profile information and correct assignments.
leagueRules.correctData: All data must be correct, complete and plausible.
leagueRules.rejectManipulation: Implausible or manipulated submissions may be rejected or removed.
leagueRules.manualReview: Claims, evidence and corrections may be reviewed manually.
leagueRules.submissionMethods: Hikes can be submitted using the methods offered in the form. These include manual submission with evidence and import via Garmin Connect. The existing evidence, eligibility and plausibility rules for private hikes and official events still apply.
leagueRules.evidenceReview: If there are discrepancies, the review team may request an explanation or additional evidence. Manipulated evidence and deliberately false information are prohibited.
leagueRules.manualApproval: Manually submitted hikes must be approved by an administrator before they count towards the rankings.
leagueRules.garminPrivateVerification: Private hiking activities imported via Garmin Connect can be accepted after successful automatic Garmin verification without additional manual approval from an administrator.
leagueRules.garminEventApproval: Event participations submitted via Garmin Connect must still be reviewed and approved by an administrator.
leagueRules.garminConnection: Connecting to Garmin Connect alone does not verify any individual activity.
leagueRules.oneSubmission: The same hike may only be submitted for scoring once. This also applies when different evidence methods are used. For a correction, refer to the existing submission.
leagueRules.fairnessGoal: The league aims to provide a fair, transparent and clear scoring system.

faq.intro: Key questions about the Ultimate European Hiking League.
faq.costQuestion: Does it cost anything to take part?
faq.whyLogQuestion: Why should I log my hikes?
faq.whyLogAnswer: See your entire performance at a glance: total distance, elevation gain, speed and progress. No filters or calculations needed.
faq.comparisonQuestion: Is it just about comparing yourself with others?
faq.comparisonAnswer: No. You can also compare your own results and see how your performance changes over time.
faq.displayNameQuestion: How can I change my display name from a pseudonym to my real name?
faq.gpxAnswer: Yes. When file import is available in the activity form, you can upload a GPX, FIT or TCX file up to 4 MB. Review the imported data and add any missing details before submitting the activity.
faq.eventsQuestion: Do I have to take part in official events?
faq.eventsAnswer: No. You can log your own hikes as well.
faq.trackingQuestion: Do I have to track my hikes?
faq.trackingAnswer: Yes, but you can use any app (Garmin, Komoot, Outdooractive, etc.).
faq.garminQuestion: How do I connect Garmin Connect to the Ultimate Hiking League?
faq.garminAnswer: Garmin Connect makes it easy to transfer recorded hikes to the Ultimate Hiking League without entering the distance, time and elevation gain yourself.
faq.signIn: Sign in to the Ultimate Hiking League and open your account.
faq.connect: Connect your Garmin account to UHL and grant the required permissions.
faq.sync: Record your hikes on your Garmin watch as usual and sync them with Garmin Connect.
faq.import: In Ultimate Hiking League, click “Wanderung hinzufügen” (Add hike) and choose “Aus Garmin importieren” (Import from Garmin).
faq.check: Choose the hike you want and check the details imported automatically.
faq.onlyNewGarminActivities: Only activities Garmin sends to UHL after you connect your account are imported. Older hikes are not imported retrospectively.
faq.garminThresholds: A hike must be at least 10 km long. Shorter hikes also count if they have at least 600 metres of elevation gain.
faq.garminMetrics: Your Garmin measurements are imported automatically and cannot be changed manually.
faq.disconnect: You can disconnect Garmin at any time in your account.
faq.timeQuestion: Why does total elapsed time count instead of walking time?
faq.timeOverview: Total elapsed time matters because it reflects actual hiking performance.
faq.timeBreaks: Breaks are part of that performance, whether for food, rest or a short stop. Hikers who pace themselves and take efficient breaks have an advantage.
faq.movingTime: Using only walking time (“moving time”) would distort the result because it leaves out important aspects of endurance performance.
faq.timeRule: 👉 This is why the Ultimate Hiking League always uses total elapsed time from start to finish.
faq.secondsQuestion: Do I need to include the seconds in my total elapsed time?
faq.secondsAnswer: No. Please enter only hours and minutes.
faq.reviewQuestion: What happens after I submit a hike?
faq.reviewAnswer: Your hike is reviewed and then displayed in your profile and in the rankings.
faq.pastQuestion: Can I log hikes from last year?
faq.pastAnswer: No. We only consider entries from the current season / calendar year.
faq.timelineQuestion: Why isn't my hike showing up in my timeline?
faq.timelineAnswer: It probably does not meet one of our league rules. Check the admin note or your emails, including the spam folder.
faq.otherAppsQuestion: How is this different from other apps?
faq.otherAppsAnswer: Other apps show individual activities. The league shows your overall performance, all at a glance.

christmasChallenge.rankingIntro: All hikers registered for the Christmas Challenge 2026.
christmasChallenge.termsIntro: The following rules and terms apply when you enter the Christmas Challenge 2026.
christmasChallenge.registrationEligibility: Entry is free and requires a personal Ultimate European Hiking League profile.
christmasChallenge.canRegisterUntil: You can register for the Christmas Challenge up to and including
christmasChallenge.registrationFinal: You cannot register once the challenge has started. Registration commits the league profile to take part in the challenge. Withdrawal after registration is not available.
christmasChallenge.activityDates: The challenge counts verified hikes with an activity date from 20 October through 15 December 2026, inclusive.
christmasChallenge.minimumIntro: A qualifying activity must cover at least
christmasChallenge.minimumOutro: and meet the usual Ultimate European Hiking League evidence and verification requirements.
christmasChallenge.verificationDeadline: , have been fully submitted and verified. Late submissions or verifications do not count for the Christmas Challenge, even if the hike took place within the challenge period.
christmasChallenge.noSeparateSubmission: Kilometres are not submitted separately for the challenge. A league entry submitted normally and verified on time counts automatically if it meets the challenge requirements. Those kilometres also continue to count in the regular UHL standings.
christmasChallenge.rankInitial: All registered participants appear in the public challenge rankings and start with 0.00 kilometres.
christmasChallenge.rankDistance: Rank is determined by the total valid and verified challenge kilometres during the challenge period.
christmasChallenge.noMinimumTotal: There is no minimum total. Participants with no qualifying kilometres remain in the rankings.
christmasChallenge.tieIntro: If two or more participants cover exactly the same total distance, rank is decided in this order:
christmasChallenge.tieEarlier: The final distance total was reached on an earlier calendar day.
christmasChallenge.tieElevation: Greater total verified elevation gain across all qualifying challenge activities.
christmasChallenge.tieNoDraw: The winner is determined by verified performances in the challenge. There is no random draw.
christmasChallenge.firstPlace: The participant ranked first in the final challenge rankings wins a
christmasChallenge.watch: new Garmin Venu Sq in black
christmasChallenge.delivery: The prize is sent by post. After the challenge, the winner provides a suitable postal address and agrees to its one-time processing for delivery of the prize.
christmasChallenge.addressPrivacy: The address is used only to deliver the prize and is not shown publicly.
christmasChallenge.noCash: The Ultimate European Hiking League offers no cash alternative or exchange. Once the prize has been handed over, the winner may do with it as they wish.
christmasChallenge.evidence: The usual Ultimate European Hiking League evidence and verification rules apply to all qualifying activities.
christmasChallenge.invalidEntries: Clearly incorrect, incomplete or manipulated data may be excluded or corrected. If activities that already count are later found to be invalid, the corresponding kilometres may be removed from the challenge rankings.
christmasChallenge.manipulation: Deliberate attempts to manipulate results may lead to disqualification from the Christmas Challenge.
christmasChallenge.finalDate: The Christmas Challenge ends on 15 December 2026. The rankings are then reviewed and the final standings established.
christmasChallenge.finalStandings: No additional kilometres can be added after the challenge ends. The final rankings established after the review determine who receives the prize.
christmasChallenge.contactWinner: The winner is contacted using the details in their league account and asked to provide a postal address.
christmasChallenge.winnerDeadline: If the winner does not respond within 14 days of notification or does not provide the required postal address, the prize may pass to the next-ranked participant under these rules.
christmasChallenge.publicProfile: By entering, participants agree that during the challenge their public league profile will be shown in the public challenge rankings with display name, country, rank and qualifying challenge kilometres.
christmasChallenge.privateData: Other personal information, including email and postal addresses, is not published as part of this.
christmasChallenge.exceptional: The Ultimate European Hiking League reserves the right to change, suspend or end the challenge early in the event of technical problems, force majeure or other exceptional circumstances if it cannot otherwise be run properly.
christmasChallenge.existingRules: Scoring rules already in effect will not be changed arbitrarily after the fact. Necessary changes will be communicated transparently and are intended to treat participants as equally as possible.

milestoneRules.title: Milestone rules & redemption
milestoneRules.intro: Find out how the Milestone Shop works and who to contact about redemption.
milestoneRules.verified: Milestones are credited for eligible verified hikes. You can find your available balance in your hiker profile and in the Milestone Shop.
milestoneRules.singleHike: The multiplier depends on the distance of the individual hike, rather than your accumulated kilometres.
milestoneRules.rounding: The distance stored in the verified record is used. Decimal places are first discarded. The full kilometres are then multiplied by the multiplier. Any remaining half Milestone is also rounded down.
milestoneRules.tiers: The multiplier is determined by the stored distance: from exactly 30 km it is 1.5, and from exactly 100 km it is 2. It applies to all full kilometres of that hike.
milestoneRules.caption: Milestone multipliers per eligible hike
milestoneRules.examples: More examples: 31 km earns 46 Milestones (31 × 1.5 = 46.5, rounded down to 46). 99.9 km earns 148 Milestones (99 × 1.5 = 148.5, rounded down to 148). Exactly 100 km earns 200 Milestones.

privacy.accessDetails: When you visit this website, technically necessary data may be processed, including information about your browser, operating system and device, the date and time of access, and other technically necessary connection data. We process this data to keep the website secure and reliable.
privacy.accountsDetails: When you create an account or submit content to the platform, we process the data you provide to operate the Ultimate Hiking League features. This may include account details, profile information, submitted hikes, uploaded evidence and information you provide voluntarily.
privacy.accountsPurpose: We process this data where necessary for your use of the platform and to handle your request or submission.
privacy.hikeData: When you submit a hike, we process the link to your account, activity details and attached evidence. Depending on the submission, this includes the date, distance, elapsed time, elevation gain and event information. We use this data to handle your submission, verify the result, prevent duplicate scoring and score approved results under the league rules. Where the processing is necessary for your participation, it is based on Article 6(1)(b) GDPR.
privacy.manualReview: The review team checks manually submitted hikes against the uploaded evidence. We use Vercel to host the website and Supabase for sign-in, the database and evidence storage.
privacy.publishedHikes: Once approved, your displayed profile name and performance data such as distance, elapsed time, elevation gain and placing may appear publicly. Approved results from official events are listed publicly. For private hikes, the visibility selected on the form applies. Evidence files do not appear in the rankings.
privacy.evidenceRetention: We keep submissions and evidence for as long as needed for review, scoring or follow-up questions. You can send deletion requests to ultimatehikingleague@gmail.com. We also consider statutory retention obligations and any retention necessary for legal claims when handling these requests.
privacy.milestoneData: For the Milestone Shop, we process the link to your user account and hiker profile, points credits and deductions, and allocated rewards and voucher codes, including their status and the allocation time. We use this information to calculate your balance, carry out and document redemptions, and prevent duplicate code allocations. The legal basis is Article 6(1)(b) GDPR where processing is necessary to provide and use the Milestone offering.
privacy.merchantData: Data is stored on the Supabase infrastructure we use. The current code allocation process does not automatically send your name, email or address to the retailer. When you redeem a code on a retailer’s website, the retailer is responsible for processing the data you enter there. See the retailer’s privacy notice for details.
privacy.milestoneRetention: We retain the account link and transaction history as needed to manage your balance, give you access to allocated codes and resolve redemption queries. The retention criteria and your data protection rights described below also apply.
privacy.privateActivities: Once connected, you can view synced activities in a private list.
privacy.garminConsent: To connect voluntarily, you sign in to Garmin and grant access to your activities there. Your consent under Article 6(1)(a) GDPR is the intended legal basis for connecting, importing the data Garmin provides and displaying it privately. The connection requires your Garmin identifier, the permissions granted and technical access tokens.
privacy.activitySource: Garmin Connect is the source of the activity data. Data intended for private selection in your UHL account and for subsequent review includes the activity identifier, type, date, distance, elapsed time, elevation gain and, where applicable, information about the data source. You should explicitly select on the form which activity should be published following automated review. Where processing is necessary for the participation you request, Article 6(1)(b) GDPR is the intended legal basis.
privacy.garminProcessing: Garmin processes sign-in and access permissions under its own privacy notices. Vercel is intended to provide the interface and Supabase to store the data. Authorized members of the review team are intended to have access to later amendment requests. We do not sell Garmin data. We do not plan to share API data with external OCR or AI providers.
privacy.garminPublication: Data from the direct connection is intended for public display once you explicitly select “Publish hike”, it passes automated review, and publication is within the use agreed with Garmin. Before submission, you should be able to see which details may appear publicly, such as your displayed profile name, distance, elapsed time, elevation gain and placing in rankings or challenges. Access tokens and the private activity list are excluded from publication.
privacy.garminRetention: At launch, you will be able to disconnect through your UHL account, and a revocation of access granted to Garmin is intended to be processed. No new activities should be imported after that point. You can withdraw consent at any time with future effect. This does not affect the lawfulness of processing before withdrawal. Retention periods for access tokens, unsubmitted activities, submissions and scores, and information about any transfers to third countries, will be added before activation. For deletion requests, withdrawal of consent or to exercise your rights under Section 9, contact ultimatehikingleague@gmail.com.
privacy.supabaseDetails: We use Supabase for database, authentication and storage functions. Personal data may be processed where necessary to operate the platform, particularly to manage accounts, sign-ins, submissions and uploaded files.
privacy.cookieConsent: This website uses technologies necessary for its operation. We use analytics technologies only if you have explicitly consented.
privacy.changeConsentLead: You can make your choice in the cookie notice on your first visit. You can later use
privacy.changeConsentEnd: to change or reset your decision.
privacy.analyticsDetails: If you have consented, we use Google Analytics, a web analytics service provided by Google, to analyze use of our website and improve what we offer.
privacy.analyticsActivation: Google Analytics loads on this website only after your active consent. If you select necessary technologies only, Google Analytics is not activated.
privacy.analyticsData: Google Analytics may process information about your use of the website, including pages visited, interactions, technical information about your browser and device, and approximate location data.
privacy.googleNotice: For more information on Google Analytics, see Google’s privacy notices.
privacy.legalBasisDetails: Where we process necessary data to operate the website, handle your request or provide platform features, we rely on the relevant statutory legal bases.
privacy.analyticsBasis: We use analytics technologies such as Google Analytics only on the basis of your consent.
privacy.retentionDetails: We keep personal data only for as long as necessary for the relevant purposes or as required by statutory retention obligations.
privacy.rightsDetails: Subject to statutory requirements, you have the right to access personal data we hold about you, rectify inaccurate data, request erasure or restriction of processing, and object to processing. Where processing is based on consent, you can withdraw consent at any time with future effect. Articles 15 to 21 GDPR set out these rights, with the right to data portability provided by Article 20 GDPR.
privacy.complaints: You also have the right to lodge a complaint with a data protection supervisory authority.
privacy.store: Outdoor Store: Orders, payments and withdrawal
privacy.storeOrders: For orders, we process names, delivery and billing addresses, email addresses, telephone numbers where applicable, items, quantities, shipping choices and payment status for performance of the contract (Article 6(1)(b) GDPR). We pass necessary delivery data to the production and shipping providers we use to calculate shipping and fulfill orders. Full card details are processed exclusively by the selected payment provider. Payments are made through Stripe or PayPal, whose privacy notices also apply to their processing.
privacy.storeProviders: We store order and invoice data securely in our Supabase database. The website is hosted on Vercel. We use Resend to send contract confirmations and acknowledgments of electronic withdrawals. These services may process data outside the EU or EEA. The agreed processing and transfer arrangements apply, particularly EU standard contractual clauses where applicable. For more information, see the providers’ privacy notices: stripe.com/privacy, paypal.com/privacy, supabase.com/privacy, vercel.com/legal/privacy-policy and resend.com/legal/privacy-policy.
privacy.storeWithdrawal: The electronic withdrawal function records your name, the email address you give, details of the contract you are withdrawing from and the time of receipt so we can process your withdrawal and acknowledge receipt (Article 6(1)(b) and (c) GDPR). Account registration is not required. Order access is protected by a technically necessary, time-limited security cookie. To prevent abuse, we briefly process a pseudonymized request key based on our legitimate interest in secure operation (Article 6(1)(f) GDPR).
privacy.storeRetention: Invoice documents subject to retention are generally kept for eight years. Other documents with retention obligations under commercial or tax law are kept for six or ten years, depending on their category (Article 6(1)(c) GDPR). Other order and withdrawal data is deleted when no longer needed for contract performance, legal claims or statutory retention. You can request information about the specific recipients of your data from the contact address below.
privacy.contactDetails: If you have questions about data protection, you can contact us at any time:

purchase.title: Orders, payment and delivery
purchase.body:
Seller: Philipp Dobrinski / ULTIMATE, sole proprietor, Ansbacher Straße 4a, 91452 Wilhermsdorf, Germany. Contact: ultimatehikingleague@gmail.com.

The contract language is German. The product listing is an invitation to place an order. Before paying, you can review and correct your entries and check the total amount. You place your order when you complete the final step that obliges you to pay at the payment provider. We accept the order when successful payment is confirmed. If the total is €0, select “Place free order” to submit it. We accept it when the order is confirmed. You receive the contract confirmation, order details and withdrawal information by email. After the order is confirmed, a PDF invoice is also available on the order confirmation page. Please save your documents, as local access to the order is time-limited.

All prices are in EUR. VAT is not shown pursuant to Section 19 UStG. The shipping charges displayed before payment are added to the product price. We do not charge you separately for production, payment services or other internal processing. Payment by PayPal or credit or debit card is due when you order. We deliver to the confirmed delivery address in Germany, Austria or Switzerland. The estimated production and delivery time displayed for the selected shipping option runs from confirmation of payment. Statutory rights concerning defects apply.

The standard hiking calendar is printed to order and is not personalized for the customer. The right of withdrawal still applies. Please return goods to the seller’s address listed above, not to the production facility.

withdrawal.title: Withdrawal and returns
withdrawal.body:
Instructions on withdrawal for goods

You have the right to withdraw from this contract within fourteen days without giving any reason. The withdrawal period expires fourteen days from the day on which you, or a third party designated by you other than the carrier, takes physical possession of the last goods.

To exercise your right of withdrawal, you must inform us (Philipp Dobrinski / ULTIMATE, Ansbacher Straße 4a, 91452 Wilhermsdorf, Germany, email: ultimatehikingleague@gmail.com) of your decision to withdraw from this contract by a clear statement, such as a letter sent by post or an email. You may use the model withdrawal form provided, but it is not required. You can also withdraw electronically using the “Withdraw from the contract” button on our website. If you use this function, we will promptly send you an acknowledgment by email.

To meet the withdrawal deadline, it is sufficient to send your notice that you are exercising the right of withdrawal before the withdrawal period expires.

Effects of withdrawal
If you withdraw from this contract, we will reimburse all payments we received from you, including delivery costs, except for additional costs arising from your choice of a delivery method other than the least expensive standard delivery we offer. We will reimburse you without undue delay and no later than fourteen days from the day we receive notice of your withdrawal from this contract. We will use the same means of payment as you used for the original transaction unless you expressly agreed otherwise. In no case will you incur any fees as a result of the reimbursement.

We may withhold reimbursement until we have received the goods back or until you have supplied evidence that you sent them back, whichever is earlier.

You must send back or hand over the goods to Philipp Dobrinski / ULTIMATE, Ansbacher Straße 4a, 91452 Wilhermsdorf, Germany, without undue delay and in any event no later than fourteen days from the day you inform us of your withdrawal from this contract. The deadline is met if you send the goods before the fourteen-day period expires.

You bear the direct cost of returning the goods.
You are liable for any diminished value of the goods only if it results from handling beyond what is necessary to establish their nature, characteristics and functioning.

Model withdrawal form
(If you wish to withdraw from the contract, please complete and return this form.)
To: Philipp Dobrinski / ULTIMATE, Ansbacher Straße 4a, 91452 Wilhermsdorf, Germany, ultimatehikingleague@gmail.com
I/we (*) hereby give notice that I/we (*) withdraw from my/our (*) contract for the purchase of the following goods: ...
Ordered on (*) / received on (*): ...
Name of consumer(s): ...
Address of consumer(s): ...
Signature of consumer(s) (only if submitted on paper): ...
Date: ...
(*) Delete as appropriate.

Statutory rights concerning defects are unaffected. If you receive defective goods, please contact us. The seller bears the costs necessary to provide the statutory remedy.
